prompts.spirits:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for original game TINIKAMI.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly 8 columns by 5 rows, 40 isolated sprites. Canvas 2048x1280, each cell 256x256. No labels, no borders, no backdrop, real transparent alpha. Each spirit fully contained in its cell with at least 32px padding, centered in cell, no overlapping neighbors. All shown three-quarter view facing right, entire body, feet/base aligned near cell y=208. Consistent pixel-art, visibly square pixel clusters (like artwork drawn at 64x64 per cell and nearest-neighbor enlarged 4x), crisp dark plum outlines, no antialiasing, no blur. Inspired by early handheld RPG battle illustrations placed in an overworld, but completely original folkloric nature spirits, not existing characters. Warm parchment highlights, jade, dusty teal, muted violet, vermilion and amber palette, 6-10 colors per spirit. Strong wildly distinct silhouettes, tiny soulful eyes, sacred masks, leaves, bells, paper talismans and elemental wisps, mischievous and mysterious rather than generic animals. No text.
Exact row-major subjects, one per cell:
Row 1: 1 ember shrine-fox spirit with burning glass tail; 2 round thorn-hedgehog shrine spirit carrying moss; 3 delicate stained-glass dragonfly spirit; 4 angular lightning jackal spirit with brass lightning ears; 5 squat marsh toad spirit with mud mask; 6 massive basalt boar spirit with stone tusks; 7 long-eared frost hare spirit with crystalline scarf; 8 violet shadow cat spirit with crescent face.
Row 2: 9 iron-winged moth spirit with mirror mask; 10 coiled turquoise river eel spirit with water ribbon; 11 tiny quill rat spirit carrying paper charms; 12 golden sun stag spirit with branch antlers; 13 squat grave mole spirit with burial lantern; 14 floating prismatic ray spirit with folded diamond wings; 15 thorn mantis spirit with leaf blades; 16 moss shrine guardian spirit like walking cairn.
Row 3: 17 jade wind crane spirit with enormous curling crest; 18 ash ram spirit with smoking spiral horns; 19 clockwork fish spirit with antique brass wheel; 20 void urchin spirit with hollow white face inside black spines; 21 candle wax wyrm spirit with small flame and dripping coil; 22 ribbon monkey spirit with huge paper-ribbon tail; 23 salt-crystal crab spirit with white shield claws; 24 nectar bat spirit with flower wings.
Row 4: 25 bell ox spirit with bronze temple bell back; 26 little anvil newt spirit with iron head and orange belly; 27 sand skink spirit with swirling dunes tail; 28 kelp widow spirit with long elegant green seaweed legs; 29 furnace lizard spirit with ember belly and smoke crest; 30 moon calf spirit with ivory crescent horns and blue shroud; 31 copper gecko spirit with coin-like scales; 32 orchard boar spirit with tiny flowering tree growing on back.
Row 5: 33 ink heron spirit with calligraphy-brush plumage; 34 hook lynx spirit with hooked paper talon tassels; 35 slag jaw spirit like a squat living crucible; 36 dew otter spirit with water-drop mask and pale scarf; 37 echo fish spirit with concentric fin rings; 38 latch spider spirit with spindle and thread legs; 39 flint roc spirit with chipped stone wings; 40 oath hound spirit with red shrine rope collar.
This is a game-engine atlas: grid placement and transparency are mandatory. Every sprite must feel like a designed spirit character, clear at 64px. No ground shadows outside the sprites.
prompts.environment:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TINIKAMI game environment tile atlas.
Create a 1024x1024 transparent PNG, exact 4 columns x 4 rows grid, 256x256 per cell. No labels, no grid lines. Original atmospheric miniature spirit shrine wilderness, early handheld RPG pixel art enlarged, square crisp pixels, limited sage green, jade, warm parchment, plum-black, vermilion and muted teal palette. Orthographic top-down with slightly visible front faces, consistent gentle light upper left. Engine will cut each cell separately.
First 12 cells are FULL SQUARE terrain textures filling their cell precisely to every edge, no border or vignette, seamless-looking:
row 1: soft pale sage meadow with sparse tiny grass tufts; warm sandy ochre footpath; mossy old square paving stones; dark teal pool water with restrained light blue ripples.
row 2: frosty pale turquoise ice with geometric cracks; brown wet mud with footprints and puddles; deep plum oil slick with subtle iridescent teal streaks; dense short jade reeds and broad leaves.
row 3: bright orange small flame tongues over scorched charcoal; soft pale sage-gray steam wisps on gray green ground; dark water with small golden lightning fissures; sparse pale flowers on light meadow.
Last row four ISOLATED props, transparent background, centered within each 256px cell with 32px margin, consistent top-down/three-quarter game view: a squat moss-covered standing stone boulder with paper talisman; a small wooden wind shrine with a red ribbon and tiny bell; an ivory lotus on a jade circular stone pedestal; a cluster of dark jade leafy shrubs with tiny white spirit lights.
No creatures, no text, no perspective scene. Strictly usable sprite sheet. Avoid soft painting, gradients, photorealism.
prompts.effects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production VFX atlas for original pixel-art spirit game TINIKAMI. One PNG with real transparent background, exact 4 columns x 4 rows, 1024x1024 pixels, 16 cells each256x256. Every isolated effect centered within own cell with 36px padding, no bleeding between cells. Draw like 48x48 pixel art enlarged, hard square clusters and dark plum outlines, bright cores, restrained jade teal, amber, vermilion, icy pale blue, violet. No labels, no characters, no scene, no ground. Early handheld battle spell visuals, original nature-spirit magic.
Row1: a curved ivory crescent slash with amber edge; rightward flying orange spirit-fire comet; jagged golden lightning bolt flying right; rightward icy spear surrounded by crystals.
Row2: turquoise water spiral with splashing droplets; green thorn leaf blade flying right; violet ink wisp flying right; a three-ribbon jade wind gust flying right.
Row3: an amber circular seal with four little shrine paper charms (no readable letters); a tiny floating wax candle sentry; a spiky purple thorn trap; a crystalline pale-blue guardian shield.
Row4: a gold-white impact starburst; a red-orange explosion flower; a jade healing lotus blossom; an airy teal afterimage/dodge arc.
Each shape should be clear and bright, with transparent holes and background. Crisp designed silhouettes, no diffuse glow or soft blur.
